source_text: Haec sunt nomina filiorum Israel qui ingressi sunt in Aegyptum cum Iacob; animae septuaginta quinque. Aegyptus — mundus in quem populus descendit ad incolendum. Est Israel secundum carnem et secundum spiritum; verus Israelita sine dolo.
pass_a_gloss: These are names of-sons of-Israel who entered into Egypt with Jacob; souls seventy-five. Egypt — world into which people descended for sojourning. There-is Israel according-to flesh and according-to spirit; true Israelite without guile.
pass_b_english: [[These are the names of the sons of Israel who entered Egypt with Jacob >> Bible:Exodus 1:1-5]]; seventy-five souls. Egypt is the world into which God’s people descend to sojourn. There is [[Israel according to the flesh >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:18]] and according to the spirit; [[a true Israelite in whom is no guile >> Bible:John 1:47]].
